changelog:
v2.8.1 — 📡 EMPIRE TALK (SLIM BUILD)

Same Empire Talk, less than half the size: 18MB instead of 43MB. The fat build carried emulator CPU engines your phone does not have — this one only carries real-phone chips, so the download completes properly on mobile data.

Empire Talk inside: claim @yourhandle, internet voice calls between handles, WhatsApp-style Recent Chats hub with previews, chat history, incoming call cards, 🔴 in-call recording (WAV into your recordings library), mute. Honest Phase 1 note: incoming calls ring while the Empire app is open; push-ringing with the app closed is the next build (Firebase engine already armed).

HOW TO USE: open Empire Talk → claim your handle → your people install v2.8.1 + claim theirs → call and chat by handle.
